title: Mrs. Vivien Hidary: "Parashat Nissavim"

chapters.title: Introduction to Parashat Nissabim
chapters.about: Defining the term nitzavim in Debarim

chapters.title: The Concept of a Human Monument
chapters.about: Nitzavim as a testament and standing tall

chapters.title: Avraham Abinu and the Angels
chapters.about: Connecting nitzavim to Avraham's hospitality and faith

chapters.title: Yaakov Abinu's Journey
chapters.about: Yaakov's psyche and the meaning of makom

summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the meaning of the word "nitzavim" in Parashat Nissabim, explaining how it signifies being a human monument that stands before Hashem. She connects this concept to the experiences of Avraham Avinu and Yaakov Abinu, illustrating how one can maintain a sense of purpose and connection to Hashem even when facing personal or national thresholds.
questions: What does it mean to be 'nitzavim' before Hashem?
How does the Torah use the word 'nitzavim' to describe our role as human monuments?
What can we learn from the way Avraham Avinu interacted with the three men who visited him?
How does the story of Yaakov Abinu at the beginning of his journey help us understand our own personal thresholds?
